title: Minimal shapes
description: Very few colours and simple hard-edged shapes; a readable silhouette matters more than detail.

art_style.outline_policy: No outline; shapes are told apart by colour.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not add detail beyond the main shapes.
Do not use more than the chosen colours.
Do not use gradients or soft edges.
